after.description:
The Celestial Kingdom’s position turns on technological dependence and the politics of nanotechnological infrastructure. The material-floor best guess is weak and conditional: access to powerful fabrication elsewhere does not mean every resident controls its inputs or receives equal secure necessities. The developing Seed offers a possible change, but its projected autonomy is kept in a separate record rather than treated as this population’s already functioning material constitution.

 Human political authority and control over infrastructure relationships place the point near the concentrated reference. Resistance to dependence is not automatically rejection of every technical device, nor does foreign technical power make an AI the local sovereign. The low nonworking scenario counts cultivation, production, trade, administration, maintenance, care and useful creation. The record is a zero variant because retained roles and controlled access remain central despite the wider setting’s productive possibilities. Broad bounds preserve uncertain household detail without omitting the familiar alternative or importing the Feed’s most privileged benefits into every resident’s life.

guarantees.basis: Technological dependence and controlled inputs qualify secure ordinary access.

control.basis: Human political/infrastructure authority is central with external dependence.

nonworking.basis: Useful production and care remain work; proposed Seed autonomy is not present participation.

evidence.claim: The references describe unequal nanotechnological control, Feed dependence and the developing Seed alternative.

uncertainties: Ordinary Celestial Kingdom household allocation and participation are estimates.
No universal technical ban or completed Seed successor is asserted.

after.qualification_basis: Retain the distinct dependence-and-authority model as a qualified zero variant.

before.analysis: Resistance to foreign Feed control and development of the Seed are not proof of deliberate job preservation. The Thete public-compiler record cannot be copied to the entire Kingdom.
before.follow_up: Keep as a technological-sovereignty comparison; skip ending reconstruction.
